examples.text: Your resume should contain the answers to those questions.
examples.translation: 你的简历应该包含这些问题的答案。
examples.speechText: Your resume should contain the answers to those questions.

examples.text: The young man struggled（struggle的过去式） to recall where he was at the time the murder took place.
examples.translation: 那个年轻人竭力回想谋杀案发生时自己在哪里。
examples.speechText: The young man struggled to recall where he was at the time the murder took place.

examples.text: Will he/she make a good boss/sales manager/secretary for me?
examples.translation: 他或她能成为适合我的好老板、销售经理或秘书吗？
examples.speechText: Will he/she make a good boss/sales manager/secretary for me?

examples.text: Less than a dozen of her poems were published during her lifetime.
examples.translation: 她生前发表的诗歌不到十二首。
examples.speechText: Less than a dozen of her poems were published during her lifetime.

examples.text: To save money, you can invite your friends for a picnic.
examples.translation: 为了省钱，你可以邀请朋友去野餐。
examples.speechText: To save money, you can invite your friends for a picnic.

examples.text: Later, people tried to lift a building off its foundation, and insert rubber and steel between the building and its foundation to reduce the impact of ground vibrations.
examples.translation: 后来，人们尝试把建筑抬离地基，在建筑与地基之间放入橡胶和钢材，以减小地面震动的影响。
examples.speechText: Later, people tried to lift a building off its foundation, and insert rubber and steel between the building and its foundation to reduce the impact of ground vibrations.

examples.text: In a world surrounded by bad news, it may feel like an unhappy place sometimes.
examples.translation: 在一个被坏消息包围的世界里，有时可能会让人觉得这个世界并不快乐。
examples.speechText: In a world surrounded by bad news, it may feel like an unhappy place sometimes.

examples.text: The moment seemed to stretch out endlessly, his gaze travelling across her face, her neck, her shoulder, returning to her eyes.
examples.translation: 那一刻仿佛被无限拉长；他的目光掠过她的脸、脖子、肩膀，又回到她的眼睛上。
examples.speechText: The moment seemed to stretch out endlessly, his gaze travelling across her face, her neck, her shoulder, returning to her eyes.

examples.text: Cooper said the idea for the mobile phone came from a communication device used by the comic book character Dick Tracy.
examples.translation: Cooper说，手机的构想来自漫画人物Dick Tracy所使用的一种通信设备。
examples.speechText: Cooper said the idea for the mobile phone came from a communication device used by the comic book character Dick Tracy.

examples.text: He immediately wanted to explore everything, which we allowed under careful supervision, Yulia says.
examples.translation: Yulia说：“它立刻就想四处探索，我们允许它这样做，但会仔细看护。”
examples.speechText: He immediately wanted to explore everything, which we allowed under careful supervision, Yulia says.

examples.text: There are times when you may want to escape into another world.
examples.translation: 有时候，你可能想暂时逃进另一个世界。
examples.speechText: There are times when you may want to escape into another world.

examples.text: The presence of mountains impacts the dryness of these deserts（desert的复数形式） as well.
examples.translation: 山脉的存在也会影响这些沙漠的干旱程度。
examples.speechText: The presence of mountains impacts the dryness of these deserts as well.

examples.text: If you do get sick, know you can take steps（step的复数形式） to protect those around you.
examples.translation: 如果你确实生病了，要知道，你可以采取措施保护周围的人。
examples.speechText: If you do get sick, know you can take steps to protect those around you.

examples.text: Saving lives has always been an important mission of science.
examples.translation: 拯救生命始终是科学的一项重要使命。
examples.speechText: Saving lives has always been an important mission of science.
